review_locator: PMCID:PMC2745114, Glycosylation in immune cell trafficking; PMCID:PMC2071064, Selectin ligand review
primary_title: Direct measurements on CD24-mediated rolling of human breast cancer MCF-7 cells on E-selectin
decision_basis: The reviews identify CD24 among candidate selectin ligands and the cited primary study directly measures CD24-E-selectin binding by SPR and demonstrates CD24-dependent rolling of human breast-cancer cells under flow.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CD24 membrane context, human MCF-7 model, calcium-dependent E-selectin binding, and tumor-cell flow/shear limits; no CD24 intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2745114, Glycosylation in immune cell trafficking; PMID:15032576, Ligands for L-selectin review
primary_title: Identification of nucleolin as a new L-selectin ligand
decision_basis: The reviews identify nucleolin among reported or context-limited selectin ligands and the cited primary affinity-purification/MS study identifies cell-surface nucleolin as an L-selectin ligand on human leukocytes and hematopoietic progenitor cells.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only edge for a partly cell-surface-exposed nucleolin pool; preserve human leukocyte/progenitor context and unusual surface topology, with no physiological rolling or intracellular relay inferred.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2745114, Glycosylation in immune cell trafficking; PMCID:PMC2504360, Cell-surface nucleolin review/primary report
primary_title: Cell-surface nucleolin is a signal transducing P-selectin binding protein for human colon carcinoma cells
decision_basis: The reviews identify nucleolin as a context-limited selectin ligand and the cited primary study demonstrates cell-surface nucleolin binding to P-selectin on human colon-carcinoma cells with antibody/siRNA dependence and P-selectin-induced tyrosine phosphorylation and PI3K-p38 complex formation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve cell-surface nucleolin pool, human colon-carcinoma model, cross-linked P-selectin and PI3K/p38 signaling context; no universal nucleolin receptor role or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2745114, Glycosylation in immune cell trafficking; PMID:11051204, Selectin glycoprotein ligands review
primary_title: Identification and characterization of ligands for L-selectin in the kidney. I. Versican, a large chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan, is a ligand for L-selectin
decision_basis: The reviews identify versican among context-limited L-selectin ligands and the cited primary study purifies a kidney/tubule versican subspecies that binds L-selectin-IgG with calcium, fucoidan, and chondroitinase-sensitive inhibition.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only edge for a kidney/extravascular versican glycoform; preserve chondroitin-sulfate dependence and disease-tissue context, with no generalized leukocyte rolling or SCI inference.

primary_title: P2X4: an ATP-activated ionotropic receptor cloned from rat brain
decision_basis: ATP activates cloned rat P2X4/P2RX4 as a calcium-permeable cation channel
limitations_preserved: Preserve ATP-gated trimeric ion-channel and heterologous oocyte context; channel opening is the supported output and no SCI inference is made.

primary_title: Full sensitivity of P2X2 purinoceptor to ATP revealed by changing extracellular pH
decision_basis: ATP activates recombinant P2X2/P2RX2 in Xenopus oocytes with an ATP-gated cation current
limitations_preserved: Preserve ATP-gated channel and extracellular-pH dependence; no universal native-cell coupling or SCI inference.
